    block = seg['nodes'][bid]
    hashes = [seg['nodes'][c]['hash'] for c in block['children']]
    current_hashes[bid] = hashes

    new_hashes[bid] = hashes

    print(f"  Block {bid}: {new_hashes[bid]} ({changed})")

# Check the white indicator position
print("\nWhite indicator blocks (color W):")
for node in new_seg['nodes']:
    if node['color'] == 'W':
        print(f"  Block {node['id']}: boundary={node['boundary']}, children={node['children']}")
